tool_call_format: xml <tool_call><function=NAME><parameter=KEY>value</parameter></function></tool_call> blocks; tool definitions as JSON lines in a <tools> block in the system message
notes:
reasoning_effort is never referenced by the template, so all six levels render byte-identical to a plain call: silently ignored, not accepted and not rejected. developer is accepted and merged with a leading system message into one system turn. Mid-conversation system or developer messages are silently dropped (no error). Unknown roles are silently dropped. enable_thinking=false renders an empty ' thinking

</think>

' block; true or absent renders ' thinking
'. The preserve_thinking kwarg only affects assistant history, not the generation prompt. llama.cpp caps will report supports_reasoning_effort=false for this template (caps.cpp:569-593).
